# Findings Register — What Was Discovered, How, and What Happened to It

*Consolidated 24 September 2026 from the audit and build sessions. One row per finding, each with the **evidence** (how it was established — a command, a file, a count, not an opinion), its **impact**, its **status**, and where it is documented in detail. If you are continuing this project, this is the shortest way to learn what is broken, what is fixed, and what you must not assume.*

**Status:** ✅ fixed and pinned by a test · 🟡 partially fixed · 🔴 open · ℹ️ informational

**Headline numbers (measured 24 Sep):** tests 129 → **163 passing** (+ experiment E17, reachability audit) · backlog **5 of 103 items done, 1 partial** (B0.1–B0.4, B1.1; B1.2 part 1) · essential public datasets on disk, **none yet read by any loader** · engine-specific literals in should-be-agnostic modules **286 / 78 / 37** (cylinder-index / brand / model-number).

---

## A. Defects that misled or would have misled a reviewer

| ID | Finding | Evidence | Impact | Status | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **F01** | **Ground-truth leak in the live detector.** FlyHash calibrated on `actual.FAULT_ID == 0` — the injected fault label, which real telemetry never carries. | Read `ml/detection_pipeline.py:391`. | Novelty detection looked correct on synthetic data and could not work on anything real. | ✅ Now calibrates on a startup frame-count window. AST scan `tests/test_no_truth_leak.py` forbids any read of `FAULT_ID`/`HEALTH_INDEX`/`RUL_HOURS` in `ml/`, `twin/`, `detect/`, `sources/`. Limitation: a sortie that starts unhealthy calibrates on the fault. | IMPLEMENTATION_LOG B0.1 |
| **F02** | **A false statistical claim in the live UI.** `RULEstimator.get_conformal_rul()` was documented as split-conformal with a coverage guarantee and emitted `"90% Conformal Calibration"`. The code is a fixed 12 % margin + 18 % × anomaly score; `significance_level` doesn't change the bounds; coverage was never measured. Its test only checked `p10 ≤ p50 ≤ p90`. | Read `ml/rul_estimator.py:136-163`; read the test. | A reviewer asking "how was this calibrated?" would find nothing. | ✅ **Label corrected, numbers unchanged:** `calibrated: False`, `coverage_guarantee: "None -- uncalibrated heuristic margin"`; docstring rewritten; test pins it. The real implementation (`evaluation/conformal.py`) is still unwired. | SUPERSEDED S07 |
| **F03** | **Chinese-origin LLM as the default AI component** (Qwen3-4B, class named `LocalQwenEngine`). | `agent/llm_engine.py`; the Army cancelled 400 drone contracts in 2025 over Chinese components (sourced in `audit/10` §2.6). | A defence panel would treat it as a supply-chain red flag. | ✅ Pluggable provider (`none`/`sarvam`/`bharatgen`/`qwen`/`local-other`), **default `none`** (never contacts Ollama); user-visible "Qwen3-4B" strings removed. Ollama tags for sarvam/bharatgen are unconfirmed. 7.6 GB of Qwen weights remain on disk, vestigial. | B0.2 |
| **F04** | **Assumed engine numbers presented as a specification.** `vrde_jayem_2_2l.json` described itself as "specification" with one `source` string; only 2.2 L / inline-4 / turbo / CRDi / FADEC / 180 hp are public. It also listed an unsourced Archer-NG platform. | Compared the file to the public sources (`audit/08` §0). | Fabricated-looking provenance. | ✅ Per-field `provenance` (PUBLIC / MANUAL / ASSUMED / PLACEHOLDER) on all 5 configs; test fails if a numeric field lacks one. Added the missing **Rotax 915 iS** (the Heron Mk II engine). | B0.4 |
| **F05** | **ACES real-flight EGT read 170 °C** ("too low for an EGT"). Root cause (not the one first guessed): the name matrix is 16 characters wide and a column's decoded name *starts with its own name then runs into the next column's* (`"Water Temp EGT 1"` is the coolant channel; the real EGT 1 is `"EGT 1 EGT 2 Altn"`). Substring matching bound EGT_1 to the coolant column. | Read the raw `.mat`; corroborated by an **independent competitor decode** whose CHT matches ours to 5 significant figures. | Every sim-to-real number would have been computed on the wrong channel. | ✅ Binding fixed (start-of-string match); CHT/EGT_3/EGT_4 newly extracted. 🔴 **Units unresolved:** `m_units` has the same artifact; values (~1200–1400) are implausible as °C. **Do not quote ACES EGT/CHT in °C**; `ACES_PROVENANCE["unit_caveat"]` says so. Needs the ACES documentation PDF. | B0.3 |
| **F06** | **`docs/build/` was silently gitignored** (`.gitignore` line 40, `build/`). Every handoff document would never have been committed. | `git check-ignore -v docs/build/MENTAL_MODEL.md`. | The whole point of the handoff docs defeated. | ✅ `!docs/build/` added. | this register |
| **F07** | **Stale/incorrect statements in my own docs**: `DECISIONS.md` still called fixed defects "current"; it pointed to a non-existent `AGENTS.md`; I wrote that the research modules were "tested" (they are not — see F10). | Re-read and re-verified. | Would have misled the next LLM. | ✅ Corrected. | IMPLEMENTATION_LOG re-verification |

| ID | Finding | Evidence | Impact | Status | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **F08** | **Two parallel systems; only one runs in the demo.** Live: circular streamer → RF/rules → hardcoded RUL. Research stack (independent plant, crank chain, conformal, damage accumulation, mission reliability, twin validity/integrity, FMECA, edge): finished but disconnected. | Traced every importer from `engine_service.py`. | Every defensible number is unreachable from the demo. | 🔴 Backlog tier E1. `Frame`/`TruthRecord` + `PlantSource` exist (B1.1, B1.2 part 1) but are **not on the live path**. | MENTAL_MODEL §4; CURRENT_STATE |
| **F09** | **Seven old/new implementation pairs**, only one half of each should be wired: S01 circular streamer vs independent plant · S02 8 hardcoded faults vs 20-mode FMECA · S03 crude RUL/Go-No-Go vs four unassembled prognostic modules · S04 a **dead duplicate** of the live classifier logic (copy-pasted thresholds) · S05 20 Hz DFT vs an unbuilt 51.2 kHz DSP · S06 hardcoded Rotax constants vs `engine_config` · S07 fake vs real conformal. | Read both halves of each; traced importers. | Wiring the wrong half "produces nothing"; a threshold fixed in one copy silently diverges from the other. | 🔴 open (each has a backlog item). | SUPERSEDED_VS_CURRENT |
| **F10** | **Most research modules have zero pytest coverage.** None of `evaluation/{conformal,damage_accumulation,prognostic_metrics,validation,threshold_baseline,harness}`, `mission/*`, `reliability/*`, `edge/compressor`, `twin/{validity,integrity,residual_detector}`, `plant/virtual_engine`, `physics/{crank_dynamics,turbo,injector_faults,oil,fuel_thermal,induction,exposure}`, `mavlink_efi`, `osacbm`. Their "Verified" entries in the log are ad-hoc runs. | `grep -rl <module> tests` for each. | Wiring them blind repeats the original mistake; headline numbers are only as good as an unrepeated run. | 🔴 New backlog item **B0.9 — do this before wiring any of them.** | CURRENT_STATE §3; VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST A6 |
| **F11** | **The plant adapter is off by default on purpose.** Enabling `ANUMAAN_USE_INDEPENDENT_PLANT` silently invalidates the published 0.9751 RF accuracy (trained on the circular distribution). Deliberately **not** flipped. | Read `plant/adapter.py`'s docstring. | Flipping it would have replaced a number with nothing. | ℹ️ | SUPERSEDED S01 |
| **F12** | **51.2 kHz sensing has zero lines of code.** It exists only as a design (Draper chamber modes 5.6–20 kHz ⇒ 2.56 × 20 kHz). The live vibration path is a 20 Hz RMS scalar whose DFT physically cannot see its target. Five study docs still say "2–10 kHz". | `grep sample_rate` across `backend/`. | A future agent might "extend" `spectral_analyser.py` instead of building the DSP core. | 🔴 Build tasks E2/E3 (not wiring). | MENTAL_MODEL §5; audit/09 §2 |
| **F13** | **The system is a one-engine (Rotax 912 iS, 4-cylinder) simulator.** No engine-selection path in API or UI; **286** fixed cylinder-index, **78** brand and **37** model-number literals in 19 should-be-agnostic modules; redlines are literals in the live pipeline; the fault list is named after one engine's CAD meshes; the RUL model has an ignition harness a diesel doesn't have; `Rotax*` class names. The "engine class as configuration" headline (F31) is true for the plant, not the twin. | Ratchet-test counts; greps. | Reads as a simulation of one engine; contradicts the PS's "scalable and modular". | 🔴 Backlog tier **E12 (U1–U10)**. Enforced by `tests/test_engine_agnostic_ratchet.py` (counts may only go down). | UNIVERSALITY_AUDIT; D27 |
| **F14** | **Physics configs and 3D asset manifests share no engine ID.** Physics: `rotax_912is/914/915is`, `austro_ae300`, `vrde_jayem_2_2l`. Assets: `austro_ae330`, `tei_pd170`. AE330 ≠ AE300; PD170 has no physics config; manifest schemas differ (faults dict vs list). | Read both directories. | The half-built "engine profile" cannot be joined. | 🔴 U1. | UNIVERSALITY_AUDIT §3 |
| **F20** | **Dangling documentation pointers to a folder that doesn't exist.** `analysis/` is neither on disk nor tracked, yet the root `README.md`, `docs/README.md`, `docs/00_official_problem_statement.md`, `docs/01_problem_statement_breakdown.md`, `docs/fun_req.md`, `docs/audit/06`, `07` and `09` reference it (a leftover of the ANUMAAN-to-root restructure). | `ls analysis`; `git ls-files analysis` (0 files); grep for `analysis/`; a programmatic link check flagged `docs/README.md -> ../analysis/README.md`. | A cold reader following the index hits a dead link, in the very documents that say where to start. | 🔴 Folded into backlog **B0.5** (docs hygiene). Not edited yet: the fix is either re-pointing those references to the docs that superseded it or removing them, which is a judgement about the restructure. |
| **F21** | **The 'independent plant' is Rotax-shaped internally.** `rpm_cmd = 3000 + 2600 x throttle` is hardcoded for every engine (the VRDE diesel, rated 3,800 rpm, runs at 4,943); EGT follows one SI-style formula (`360 + 430 x load`), so the two diesels read 1,152 / 1,190 C (a real diesel ~500-750 C); 5200 rpm is a literal passed to the turbo/induction models. | Ran `PlantSource` on all 5 configs; read `plant/virtual_engine.py:309-355`. | Any cross-engine experiment on plant data is only indicative; diesels look physically wrong. | 🔴 backlog **R6** (needs B0.9 first). | UNIVERSALITY_AUDIT; DETECTOR_DECISION s7 |
| **F22** | **Injector coking, needle stick, rail-pressure decay and turbo-bearing wear leave zero trace on every scalar channel** (measured delta 0.0 on CHT, EGT, oil, fuel, MAP, rpm). They act only on the crank/rail waveform. A scalar-only system (ours, and the 11 competitor teams analysed) is structurally blind to the primary diesel fault family. | Probed all 12 plant faults on two engines. | Mandates the waveform pipeline; explains the earlier 'thermal residuals missed injector coking' result. | ℹ️ drives **W3-W6**. | DETECTOR_DECISION s4 |
| **F23** | **The live 'levers' are cosmetic** (gap G02 still open): `SET_THROTTLE/ALTITUDE/OAT` overwrite displayed fields after the frame is generated; only `SET_REGIME` changes physics. The plant itself responds correctly to all three. | Read `engine_service.py:669-682` and gap_plan G02. | A judge moving a slider sees numbers change but no physical transient. | 🔴 backlog **R3**. | MULTI_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE s3-4 |
| **F24** | **Runtime is a single-engine singleton** (`EngineStateService`, one worker thread, one streamer); `/ws/telemetry` has no engine parameter. Concurrency itself is cheap: 0.12-0.15 ms per plant step, ~1.2 % of one core for 5 engines at 20 Hz. | `grep` of routes/singleton; timed the plant. | No dropdown, no fleet view possible. | 🔴 backlog **R1, R4**. | D29 |
| **F25** | **'Blender-ready' assets are fewer than they look.** The 78 MB Rotax blend is one 912i base plus 914 and 915 *fitting sets* (31 of 112 objects match; no turbo/intercooler mesh) - variants, not three files. `austro_ae330.blend` is real (821 KB; AE330 not AE300). `tei_pd170`, the TB3 airframe and the whole Rotax 912 iS STEP CAD folder are **39 git-LFS pointer stubs** (131-133 bytes), not files. | Headless Blender object listing; file sizes; LFS header check. | Build scripts and references to those files are silently broken. | 🔴 backlog **R5**, hygiene B0.10. | MULTI_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE s8; DEAD_CODE_AUDIT s5 |

## E. What is actually strong (so the picture isn't only negative)

- Real, careful engineering exists: crank-angle chain (misfire rate recovered exactly in simulation), rainflow/Miner damage, real conformal, FMECA + isolability (55 % → 95 % with proposed sensors), mission reliability with Wilson intervals, twin-validity and physics-integrity monitors, the independent plant.
- The evaluation *discipline* is unusually good for this field (point-wise vs point-adjusted F1, mission-level splits, evidence labels, honest "unproven" columns).
- The fixes above were each small and each pinned by a test; the design (docs 07–12) is deep and specific enough to build from.

## F. How to use this register

1. New finding → add a row here with **evidence**, impact, status; if it's a *class* of mistake, add a row to `VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md` and, ideally, an automated test.
2. Fixing a finding → change its status, name the test that pins it, and log the session in `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`.
3. Never delete a row; a fixed finding is still the reason a test exists.
